about.metaDescription: Meet Colombo Market, your neighbourhood destination for Sri Lankan, Indian and international groceries in Ravensburg.
about.title: About Us
about.heroTitle: A piece of Sri Lanka and India for Germany.
about.heroBody: Our story began with a feeling familiar to many people who have left their homeland - the longing for the taste of home.
about.heroImageAlt: Fresh produce and pantry goods in a welcoming grocery market
about.storyOne: About eight years ago, our family moved to Germany. We come from traditional Sri Lankan families and brought with us our love for our homeland, our culture and, above all, our traditional cuisine.
about.storyTwo: After moving to Germany, we quickly realised how much we missed the authentic flavours and ingredients of home.
about.storyThree: This experience inspired us to build our own shop - a place where we can bring a small piece of Sri Lanka and India to Germany.
about.storyFour: We want to offer authentic Sri Lankan and Indian food and products for everyone who would like to discover these special cuisines for the first time, as well as for Sri Lankans, Indians and others living far from home who long for the familiar tastes of their childhood.
about.storyFive: When selecting our products, we place great importance on quality, authenticity and freshness.
about.storySix: Whether traditional ingredients, beloved foods from home or new specialities you would like to discover, we want to offer products that we would also choose for our own family.
about.storySeven: For us, good service is just as important as good products. We want to treat our customers with honesty, friendliness and reliability, and are happy to help whenever you have questions or are looking for something specific.
about.storyEight: We look forward to sharing our passion for Sri Lankan and Indian cuisine with you and bringing you a little closer to home.

items.a: Orders are usually processed within 1–3 business days. Estimated delivery then takes a further 2–5 business days.

items.q: Can I pick up my order in Ravensburg?
items.a: Yes. If pickup is offered at checkout, you can collect your order free of charge from our store at Herrenstraße 30, 88212 Ravensburg. Please wait for your pickup confirmation before visiting the store.
Shipping within Germany is free for orders of €59.99 or more. Available shipping options are shown at checkout.

Contact us within 14 days of receiving your order. Returns generally need to be unused, unopened and in their original packaging. Exceptions apply to opened food products and perishable goods. Please contact us before sending anything back.

items.q: How can I contact Colombo Market?
items.a: For questions about orders, products, delivery or pickup, contact us by email at colombomarket.rv@gmail.com.
